claim: The 2026 Annecy Animation Festival runs June 21-27 (Mifa market June 23-26), moved later than usual because the G7 Summit will occupy Haute-Savoie on the original dates.
quote: The festival will run from June 21-27, 2026, with the Mifa market operating June 23-26. The French President announced on June 17 that the G7 Summit would be held in Haute-Savoie during the originally scheduled festival dates.

claim: The 2026 edition is the 50th Annecy Animation Festival and the general public can attend screenings alongside the industry Mifa market.
The Fête du Lac d'Annecy 2026 takes place Saturday 1 August, a 70-minute pyrotechnic show titled 'L'Âme du Monde' built in 7 acts, billed as Europe's largest fireworks display.
Fête du Lac tickets run roughly €4-€55 for adults; numbered grandstands from about €23, lawn seating from about €6.50; physical sales opened 2 June 2026 with online sales from 22 June.
quote: Fête du Lac Annecy 2026 : billetterie pour le feu d'artifice, prix, horaires

claim: The Musée-Château occupies a 13th-16th century castle (30m Tour de la Reine), opens 10:00-17:30 (10:30-18:00 in summer), closed Tuesdays, admission €6.50-€7 full / €3.50-€4 reduced, free under 12.
quote: Standard admission ranges from €6.50-€7.00 depending on season, with reduced rates at €3.50-€4.00... closed Tuesdays... a 13th-16th century castle... including the 30-meter-high Tour de la Reine.

claim: The Palais de l'Île, a 12th-century 'house in the shape of a ship' that was a prison until 1864, opens daily except Tuesday; admission €4 adults / €2 children (€5/€2.50 in July-August), free under 12.
quote: Open every day except on Tuesday... January-June & September-December: €4 adults, €2 children; July-August: €5 adults, €2.50 children... a prison until 1864.

claim: The Annecy old-town market runs Tuesday, Friday and Sunday roughly 7:00-13:00 along Rue Sainte-Claire and adjacent old-town streets, with Sunday the largest day.
The Musée-Château and Palais de l'Île offer free entry on the first Sunday of the month from October to May.
